git_rationale.root_cause_commit: N/A — multi-item residual closure; no single regression commit
git_rationale.why_issue_occurred: Six §5.3 super-checklist sub-items remained unaddressed after cycle 3. C.2 had a duplicated basename because outer ToolView.extractSubtitle and inner CodexPatchViewFull fileHeader both surfaced the file identity. F.4 had no knownTools entries for browser_navigate / _evaluate / _run_code / _type. G.4 had renderer keys but no fixture rows. B.7 had a generic literal fallback instead of a user-actionable advisory. E.2/I.2 fixture descriptions described rendering quality, not the out-of-frontend-scope nature of those spec items.
git_rationale.how_fix_addresses_root: Each fix targets the smallest necessary change at the correct layer. C.2 sets extractSubtitle to null instead of refactoring the patch view (preserves both rendering paths' guards). F.4 adds four discrete knownTools entries adjacent to the existing browser_take_screenshot entry — the canonical extension point — rather than broadening buildGenericToolSummary's responsibilities. G.4 adds fixture rows that match summarizeWebResult's existing array-shape scan; no helper changes. B.7 replaces only the generic fallback literal, preserving the ?? precedence so mapper-supplied reasons still win. E.2/I.2 are description-only edits to fixture rows.
